name: Испытательный центр
approval_context: The original E2 set passed an initial content/monitor review on 2026-10-30, but a later side-by-side E0→E1→E2 blind-order review found a blocking style-family mismatch: the E2 sheets are substantially more photorealistic/render-like than the canonical E0/E1 pixel-look references. Engineering content remains useful evidence, but E2 is not an approved canonical visual reference set until same-style correction sheets replace or supersede the current three sheets.

authority.note: Generated lettering/pseudo-text inside reference sheets is non-authoritative; use the imagery for era language only.

preserved: industrial serviceability, standardized safety language and visible technical infrastructure
physical electromechanical construction with readable maintenance access
replaced: E1 workshop-centric cabinets and early electronics with denser rack-based test/diagnostic systems
primarily hydraulic/electromotor emphasis with motorized servo and motor-reducer systems
mixed industrial panels with a stronger beige/gray technical-plastic and aluminium laboratory language
basic organized trays with more explicit routed harnesses, connectors and diagnostic cabling
added: CRT-dominant operator and diagnostic stations in deep/bulky housings
electronic racks, ventilation grilles, modular diagnostic/service bays and replaceable electronics
denser grouped early LED indication and test instrumentation
specialized test-center buildings, measurement posts and service modules
transition_from_e1.why: The base has matured from a standardized workshop into a dedicated aerospace test center where diagnostics, instrumentation and motorized control are first-class infrastructure.
transition_from_e1.player_signal: More electronics and racks, deeper CRT stations, dense routed cabling, specialized test/diagnostic buildings and visibly motorized equipment; E2 is intentionally more technically busy than cleaner E3.

era_gate_review.engineering_distinctness: pass: E2 content is materially different from E1 on at least six era axes
era_gate_review.monitor_review: pass: displays read as bulky CRT/diagnostic terminals, not flat E3 panels; limited early LCD-like elements are not era-defining
era_gate_review.style_family_review: fail: the current E2 matrix/elements/applications sheets render substantially more photorealistically than the canonical E0/E1 HD pixel-look reference language

preserve_from_current_e2: bulky CRT operator stations and rack electronics
organized routed cable/pipe corridors and diagnostic connectors
partial automation and specialized service/test vehicles
must_change: redraw in the same cohesive HD pixel-art/pixel-look family as the approved E0/E1 references
replace photographic/render-like surfaces and lens-like realism with deliberate pixel clusters, stepped shading and selective chromatic outlines
keep E2 visibly more technical and laboratory/test-oriented than E1 without changing the era into E3
strengthen neutral/fluorescent work-light language and beige/gray technical materials so E2 is not distinguished only by density
retain CRT/rack diagnostics and avoid flat-display E3 shorthand
correction_contract.approval_rule: E2 returns to approved status only after replacement/correction sheets pass exact-SHA visual review and a side-by-side E0→E1→E2 blind-order/style-family review.

sheets.role: engineering-content evidence only until style correction: test-center base fragment, laboratory/test architecture, motorization, CRT diagnostics, racks, organized cable routes and 1998 materials/signals

engineering-content evidence only until style correction: beige/gray plastics, routed cable systems, pipes, motor-reducers, actuators, racks, gauges, CRT monitors, early LEDs, connectors and service modules

engineering-content evidence only until style correction: test/launch complex, diagnostic building, communications/radar, fuel system, service transport, power block, measurement post, hangar, test stand and cable/pipe corridors

rejected_attempts.reason: wrong era read: generator repeated E1/1986 instead of E2/1998
2026-10-30 style-correction attempt violated the one-era scope by generating a combined E0/E1/E2 comparison board instead of an E2-only correction sheet
2026-10-30 retry repeated the same one-era scope failure by generating another combined E0/E1/E2 board; retry budget exhausted for this method in the current interactive turn

usage.reference_strategy: Do not use the current E2 sheets as canonical visual-style references until same-style correction is approved. They may be consulted only for engineering-content evidence (CRT/racks/diagnostics/test-center specialization) together with the canonical era matrix and approved E0/E1 references.
usage.system_separation: Physical hardware/materials belong in art; active screen data, glow, motion, sparks, fields and temporary FX remain code-owned unless explicitly scoped otherwise.
